name: Running
summary: A foundational aerobic locomotion exercise performed at a sustainable, rhythmic pace to develop cardiovascular endurance and lower-body stamina.

setup: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed, chest open, and gaze looking forward.
Engage your core lightly and lean forward slightly from the ankles, not the waist.
steps: Push off the ground with the trailing foot, driving the opposite knee forward in a fluid gait cycle.
Land lightly with your foot close to your center of mass, using a midfoot strike.
Allow your arms to swing naturally in rhythm with your legs, keeping elbows bent at approximately ninety degrees.
Maintain a continuous, rhythmic cadence at an effort level where you can speak in full sentences without gasping.
instructions.breathing: Breathe rhythmically and smoothly through both the nose and mouth, matching your breaths to your foot strike cadence.
cues: Stay tall with a slight forward lean

common_faults.fault: Overstriding by reaching the lead foot too far forward and striking heavily on the heel.
common_faults.correction: Shorten your stride and aim for a quicker turnover, landing with your feet directly underneath your hips.

common_faults.fault: Running too fast during an intended aerobic base session.
common_faults.correction: Slow down until you can comfortably speak multiple sentences without pauses to catch your breath.

common_faults.fault: Hunching the shoulders and tensing the neck.
common_faults.correction: Drop your shoulders down away from your ears and keep your hands loosely cupped.

precautions: Ensure appropriate running footwear suitable for the surface.
Stay hydrated and avoid high heat without adequate acclimation.
